message.content:
The value of $20 USD in British pounds varies with the current exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2026), 1 USD ≈ £0.78–£0.80. Using that range:

| USD | Approx. GBP |
|-----|-------------|
| $20 | £15.60 – £16.00 |

So you can expect roughly **£15.60 to £16.00** for $20, but check a reliable financial source or your bank for the exact rate at the time of your transaction.
